description: S2-1 — Benchmark-style OCR regression suite. 5 categories × ≥ 2 cases per KB §3 (Thai form, dense, landscape, tables, multi-column). Each case declares its category, guard link (issue/report), and pass criterion. Scoring: per-case, per-category, overall. All fixtures generated deterministically from HTML via generate-fixtures.mjs.

thai-form.label: Thai form
thai-form.description: Dense Thai form-like documents. Regression class from OCR-1/2/6 (multi-line join, prefix retention, content-density on real forms).

dense.label: Dense / high-density
dense.description: High content density where attention dilution drops or blends multi-line values. Guards OCR-6 (crop-based extraction) and OCR-6b (sibling-label blend).

landscape.label: Landscape
landscape.description: A4 landscape pages where letterbox coordinate remap can drift the bbox_hint crop off target. Guards OCR-6c.

tables.label: Tables
tables.description: Structured row/col tables. Exercises the `type === "table"` credit branch and structural extraction fidelity.

multi-column.label: Multi-column
multi-column.description: Columnar disambiguation — two adjacent labels with semantically similar siblings. Model must return the target column's value. Also covers verbatim + corrections_report in 2-col layouts (OCR-2 issue 1.1/1.4).

multi-page.label: Multi-page
multi-page.description: Same-name field appears on multiple pages with different values. Prior behavior returned only page-1 value; SHARED_RULES_VERSION 2026-07-15-v3 (OCR-9) adds a rule that model must return page-tagged joined string like '[หน้า 1: X | หน้า 2: Y]'. Guards regression back to single-page-only behavior.

cases.field: เลขที่เอกสาร
cases.notes: OCR-9: PDF has same-name field 'เลขที่เอกสาร' on 2 pages with different values (DOC-001, DOC-002). Prior behavior returned only page-1 value. SHARED_RULES v2026-07-15-v3 rule requires page-tagged joined string containing BOTH values. Assertion `multiline` succeeds when both DOC-001 and DOC-002 appear in the returned string with any separator (e.g. '[หน้า 1: DOC-001 | หน้า 2: DOC-002]'). Field 'เลขที่เอกสาร' must exist in OCR_E2E_REGRESSION_TEMPLATE.

notes.runner_backcompat: Legacy configs `ocr-2.json` and `ocr-6b.json` still work — run.mjs auto-detects legacy shape (top-level `cases[].assertion` + `.expect`) vs benchmark shape (top-level `categories` + `cases[].category` + `.expected`).
notes.table_credit_branch: Table cases require a template with fields of type `table`. If OCR_E2E_TABLE_TEMPLATE is unset the runner will skip the entire `tables` category (not fail).
notes.template_hint_policy: column-disambiguation and multicolumn-2col-thai MUST run on a template with NO bbox_hint on the target field, or the test is meaningless.
notes.landscape_fixture: landscape-sibling-labels uses a real (uncommitted) source PDF. Case is auto-skipped when the file is absent (skip_if_missing: true).
